name: Slated
description:
Keyboard-first window management: Slate-compatible shortcuts, layouts, window hints and a placement grid, Caps Lock as a Hyper key, and text expansion through espanso. Reads ~/.config/slated/config.json, ~/.slate.js and ~/.slate.

Clipboard: the insert-text action pastes text it can't type through the clipboard, then puts the previous clipboard text back. Nothing is pasted unless you bind an insert-text action yourself.
